notes.title: Game Delay
notes.notes:
After consultation internally, we have come to the decision to put the game on hold. Because of education and many other things that we are personally super busy with, it is difficult to actively work on a game. We are therefore extending the current release date to an unknown date in 2023. No rights are derived from this date.

I understand that this comes as a huge setback for many. That's how it feels o
for us too. But we also think that you can only release a game that is stable enough. We request that you do not leave the discord because of this action. For those who do, we recommend adding our game to your wish list. This will give you an immediate update when we announce something about the game. There will also be no new playtest for all beta/alpha testers. The keys that have been given away at the moment will be revoked until we have more news. I want to emphasize that this is NOT the end of paranormalized.

Sincerely, Paranormalized

For more information please join our [url=https://discord.gg/kcj67Q2dum]discord server[/url] to stay tuned. You can always contact us with the modmail bot!
